newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CompDent rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CompDent rating cut.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc said Tuesday it lowered its rating on CompDent Corp to market performer from focus buy in the wake of its flat revenues of $37.8 million in the first quarter and expected lower growth for 1997 and 1998.
-- Mesirow also said it lowered its 1997 earnings estimate for CompDent to $1.16 from $1.27 and the estimate for 1998 to $1.40 from $1.64 because of reduced revenue and growth rate.
-- Increased industry competition is coming from conventional, fee-for-service insurers who are entering the PPO market faster than expected, Mesirow said.

-- CompuDent is trying to address difficulty in recruiting dentists to its PPO plans by forming a dental practice management subsidiary, Mesirow said. The new division would allow CompDent to open practices in areas where dental practice groups are difficult to reach, Mesirow said.
-- This is a long-term solution that is unlikely to have a meaningful impact in the near term, Mesirow said.
-- Its shares closed off 3/4 Tuesday at 14-1/2.
